SELECT d.nm, AVG(eph.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM dept d
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON edh.ref1 = eph.ref1
WHERE eph.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
    WHERE eph2.ref1 = eph.ref1
)
AND edh.strt_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(edh2.strt_dt)
    FROM emp_dept_hist edh2
    WHERE edh2.ref1 = edh.ref1
)
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

SELECT d.nm, AVG(eph.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM emp_pay_hist eph
JOIN (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_rt_chng_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
) latest ON eph.ref1 = latest.ref1 AND eph.rt_chng_dt = latest.max_rt_chng_dt
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = eph.ref1 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

WITH latest_pay AS (
    SELECT ref1, rt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_pay_hist
),
latest_dept AS (
    SELECT ref3, ref2,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref3 ORDER BY strt_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_dept_hist
)
SELECT d.nm AS department, AVG(lp.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM latest_pay lp
JOIN latest_dept ld ON lp.ref1 = ld.ref3 AND ld.rn = 1
JOIN dept d ON ld.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE lp.rn = 1
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, p2.nm AS component_name, 1 AS level
  FROM prod p
  JOIN bom b ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
  JOIN prod p2 ON b.ref2 = p2.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b2.ref2, p3.nm, bt.level + 1
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b2 ON b2.ref3 = bt.component_id
  JOIN prod p3 ON b2.ref2 = p3.prdc_id
)
SELECT component_name, level
FROM bom_tree

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, 1 AS lvl
    FROM bom b
    WHERE b.ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.ref2, bt.lvl + 1
    FROM bom b
    JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm AS component_name, bt.lvl AS level
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, p.nm AS component_name, 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom b

  WHERE b.ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, p.nm, bt.lvl + 1
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id

)
SELECT component_id, component_name, lvl

  SELECT b.ref3, b.ref2

)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parts_list

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (

  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.qty * b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_components

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte (component_id, qty) AS (

  JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bom_cte.qty * b.pr_assm_qty
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_cte ON b.ref3 = bom_cte.component_id
)
SELECT SUM(qty) AS total_components
FROM bom_cte

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte AS (

    SELECT b.ref3, b.ref2, b.bm_lvl, c.assembly_level + 1

    INNER JOIN bom_cte c ON b.ref3 = c.ref2
)
SELECT MAX(assembly_level) FROM bom_cte
SELECT MAX(b.bm_lvl) FROM bom b JOIN prod p ON b.ref3 = p.prdc_id WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'

WITH RECURSIVE bom_cte AS (

  SELECT b.ref3, b.ref2, cte.level + 1

SELECT CONCAT(p.frst_nm, ' ', p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl AS job_title
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY p.lst_nm

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY p.lst_nm

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist h ON h.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON h.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND h.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY p.lst_nm

SELECT stor.nm, addr.cty, st_prv.nm
FROM stor
JOIN biz_addr ON stor.ref2 = biz_addr.ref1
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref2 = addr.addr_id
JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id
ORDER BY stor.nm

SELECT stor.nm AS store_name, addr.cty AS city, st_prv.nm AS state_province
FROM stor
JOIN biz_addr ON stor.ref2 = biz_addr.ref1
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id
JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id
ORDER BY stor.nm

SELECT stor.nm, addr.cty, st_prv.nm
FROM stor
JOIN biz_addr ON stor.ref2 = biz_addr.ref1
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id
JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id
ORDER BY stor.nm

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl AS job_title
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON e.ref1 = eph.ref1
WHERE eph.rt > 50
AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
    WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
)

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist ph ON ph.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE ph.rt > 50
AND ph.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(ph2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist ph2
    WHERE ph2.ref1 = e.ref1
)

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm) AS full_name, e.jb_ttl AS job_title
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE eph.rt > 50
  AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
    SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
    FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
    WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON e.ref1 = eph.ref1
WHERE d.nm = 'Production'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
  AND e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND eph.rt > 20
  AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
      SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
      FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
      WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND d.nm = 'Production'
  AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR edh.end_dt > CURDATE())
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM emp_pay_hist eph
    WHERE eph.ref1 = e.ref1
      AND eph.rt > 20
      AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
        SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
        FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
        WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
      )
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE d.nm = 'Production'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
  AND e.crrn_flg = 1
  AND eph.rt_chng_dt = (
      SELECT MAX(eph2.rt_chng_dt)
      FROM emp_pay_hist eph2
      WHERE eph2.ref1 = e.ref1
  )
  AND eph.rt > 20

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE YEAR(sh.ordr_dt) = 2013
  AND pc.nm = 'Bikes'

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Bikes'
  AND sh.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01'
  AND sh.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Bikes'
  AND sh.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01'
  AND sh.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
